# Known vulnerabilities accepted until the lock can be upgraded. One ID per line, then a reason.
# The CI audit (.github/workflows/ci.yml) fails on any vulnerability not listed here.
# Remove an entry as soon as the fixed version is locked:
#   uv lock --upgrade-package filelock --upgrade-package litellm --upgrade-package setuptools --upgrade-package torch
#
